messages:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing hourly usage in the Console delayed by ~4 hours for multiple tenants. Charts are sparse between 02:00–06:00 UTC. Not a UI-only issue, backend rollups show missing rows.

sam: Thanks — any pattern to tenants? region? plan?

maria: Mostly NA tenants across both hosted and dedicated. Affected tens of customers so far, including acme and beta-inc. Not seeing billing spikes.

ingest-bot: alert: hourly_ingest_lag detected; partition=13 consumer_lag=18000 msgs tenant=acme

elainem: pinging @oncall-sre and @ben to get Kafka/consumer visibility.

oncall-sre: I'll pull consumer group state. Can someone paste the exact consumer group?

maria: group is analytics-hourly-ingest, topic console-hourly-rollups.

oncall-sre: running: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --describe --group analytics-hourly-ingest`

oncall-sre: output snippet: ```
TOPIC                      PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG             CONSUMER-ID
console-hourly-rollups     13         1248000         1266000         18000          consumer-4
console-hourly-rollups     14         625000          625000          0              consumer-2
```

oncall-sre: Partition 13 lag is huge; consumer-4 restarted earlier today (kube eviction). Might have missed a window.

b: can we replay those partitions or trigger reprocess? Need to be careful about double-counting.

elainem: We have a rehydration queue job (rehydrate-rollups) that de-duplicates by window id, but if offsets advance and the job drops messages it can leave gaps.

sam: Repro steps requested by support: how to show a single-tenant gap? Use SQL: `SELECT hour, count(*) FROM console_hourly_rollups WHERE tenant_id='acme' AND hour BETWEEN '2024-03-18 02:00' AND '2024-03-18 07:00' GROUP BY hour;`

maria: Ran that — shows 0 rows for 03:00 and 04:00.

oncall-sre: For immediate mitigation I can force consumer to start from earliest for partition 13 and re-run rehydrate for that range, but that will reprocess ~20k messages and will increase load. Approve?

b: Approve for a targeted backfill for acme and beta-inc only. We should avoid global replays. Create a backfill job scoped by tenant and hour range.

elainem: Steps: 1) snapshot current offsets, 2) create backfill job `rehydrate-rollups --tenant acme,beta-inc --start 2024-03-18T02:00 --end 2024-03-18T06:00 --dry-run/false`, 3) monitor metric `ingest.rehydrate.errors` and Console row counts.

oncall-sre: Snapshot command: `curl -s http://kafka-admin/api/groups/analytics-hourly-ingest | jq .partitions[13].offset` -> store.

maria: Also noticed the retention compaction job ran at ~01:50 UTC and logs show a quick spike: `retention-compact: deleting segment for topic console-hourly-rollups partition=13` — maybe compaction interacted with consumer restart.

sam: Good catch. Could be a race where compaction removed messages before the restarted consumer rewound. That would explain missing hours.

elainem: Action items: (A) Oncall will submit targeted backfill for tenants listed, (B) Ben to add a guard so rehydration respects last-known-commit and falls back to S3 snapshot when Kafka data is unavailable, (C) Support to notify impacted customers and set expectations (~2–3 hours for backfill to complete per tenant).

ben: I'll open a PR for the guard — quick patch to query s3-rollup-archive if gap > X minutes. ETA 4h.

oncall-sre: Starting backfill now for acme: `rehydrate-rollups --tenant acme --start 2024-03-18T02:00 --end 2024-03-18T05:00`

oncall-sre: backfill logs: ```INFO rehydrate: enqueued 12000 messages for tenant=acme
INFO rehydrate: processed 8000/12000 (67%)
ERROR rehydrate: transient S3 read error, retrying
INFO rehydrate: finished 12000 messages, inserted 2 missing hour rows
```

maria: After insert, console shows acme hours restored for 02:00 and 04:00, 03:00 still missing.

sam: Any errors for 03:00?

oncall-sre: 03:00 partition had a hole in Kafka (segment deleted). There's no raw data to rehydrate. We'll need to reconstruct from service-level metrics or mark as extrapolated.

b: For 03:00 do a conservative interpolation: use sum of neighboring hours divided by two and mark rows with `source=interpolated` and an audit flag. Notify customers about interpolated data.

elainem: I'll draft a notification template. Support: please escalate to acme and beta-inc with ETA and note which hours are interpolated vs rehydrated.

maria: Thanks team — keep this thread updated. If the PR goes in and prevents future rehydration misses, we can close after 24h with status.

oncall-sre: Monitoring: created dashboard widget `Hourly Ingest Lag by Partition` and alert threshold at lag>5k. Will lower to 1k while we stabilize.

b: PR: r/redwood/ingest#482. Link: https://git.company/repo/pull/482

maria: Marking customers impacted and adding to incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2024-0318-usage-lag

support-eng: Notifying customers now with latest status. :email:
